description: Header file declaring functions and enums for handling X.509 certificates with Apple Security framework integration, including creation, conversion, and fingerprint calculation.

classes.name: InvalidIntermediateBehavior
classes.description: Enumeration specifying behavior when an intermediate certificate fails parsing.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a SecCertificate handle from DER-encoded data.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates a SecCertificate handle from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateArrayForX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates an array of SecCertificates including intermediates for a given X509Certificate.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateArrayForX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates an array of SecCertificates with specified behavior for invalid intermediates.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromSecCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a SecCertificate and its chain.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromSecCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object with non-standard parsing options.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 fingerprint of a SecCertificate.

methods.name: CertificateChainFromSecTrust
methods.description: Builds a certificate chain from a SecTrustRef.
